title: Create a sandbox version: request
description: POST /api/v1/sandboxes/versions with Authorization: Bearer <project key>. Step 1 of `ratel sandbox push`: registers one version of one sandbox and asks where to upload its bundle.

manifest.description: The manifest of the pushed code. Its sandboxes list holds the pushed sandbox only.

bundle.description: The tar.gz of the project files that step 2 uploads.

files.description: The number of files in it.
